description: Index of first-party NAVIG plugins. Each extends navig (`navig <verb>`) and some also run standalone. They install from their NATIVE channel (pip / npm), not via `navig plugin add`, which git-clones and cannot install a pip or npm distribution. `published` and `released` reflect the real index at generation time: `released` is the version an install delivers, `version` is the in-repo manifest (which can run ahead of a release). An entry with published=false carries no install command on purpose.

plugins.summary: Agent Control Center (devops section): sessions, worktrees, tasks and the Agent Monitor (runs, hooks, verified lands) — one view, then a controller.

NAVIG Antivirus module — browser-extension malware/PUP scanning, Chrome extension-registry auditing, Chrome profile-index recovery, and a system malware scan (Windows Defender; Malwarebytes best-effort). Wired into `navig antivirus`. A first-party navig plugin (free, toggleable).

Speak text, transcribe audio, generate music and sound effects, analyse beats and render podcasts — its own navig-audio command, with your own provider keys; also `navig audio` / `navig voice` inside navig.

NAVIG Blackbox — a standalone flight-recorder & crash black-box for any Python app: append-only event log, sys.excepthook crash capture, and sealed .navbox incident bundles. Installs without navig; also wired into `navig blackbox`.

navig bookmarks -- a local bookmark manager: import from any browser or HTML export, full-text search, AI folder plans and tags with your own AI, dead-link checks, duplicate cleanup, and Netscape HTML export with folders.
Launch an isolated Chrome/Edge/Brave or Electron app, drive it over CDP, keep named profiles and stop only what it launched — the browser engine navig uses; runs on its own as `navig-browser`.

NAVIG Cabinet — your documents in one plugin: an encrypted cabinet for important files (ID and passport scans, medical records, contracts, photos, recordings — any type, any size; local-OCR search, expiry reminders, portable backups) plus `navig paperwork`, which files business paperwork (invoices, quotes, contracts, tax) into a space. A first-party navig plugin (free, toggleable).
NAVIG Calendar module — list/add/sync events (Google Calendar, CalDAV, ICS). A first-party navig plugin (free, toggleable).

navig chats -- a local library for your AI conversations: import your ChatGPT data export, save chats from the page with the NAVIG Dock, search every message offline, organise them in folders, and export to Markdown, HTML, JSON or a checksummed zip.

NAVIG Contacts module — `navig contacts`: the address book and the alias-to-route table dispatch resolves against, in one store. Imports vCard and Telegram exports, merges the same person out of many records, and keeps only contacts with a phone number that validates.
NAVIG Dedupe — a free, standalone perceptual duplicate finder for photos, video, audio & any file. Non-destructive (quarantine, never delete). Installs without navig; also wired into `navig dedupe`.

NAVIG Dev Host module — give any local dev server a real .test domain over trusted HTTPS in one command (hosts + mkcert + raw TLS relay), wired into `navig devhost`. A first-party navig plugin (free, toggleable).
Developer/ops network inspection: DNS/WHOIS/SSL lookups and an SSRF-guarded HTTP repeater — its own navig-devnet command, and `navig devnet` inside navig.
NAVIG Download module — universal media downloader (yt-dlp): video, audio & files from YouTube, TikTok and any supported site. A first-party navig plugin (free, toggleable).
NAVIG eBay module — sell on eBay via the official Sell APIs (draft, publish, price, orders) wired into `navig ebay`. A first-party navig plugin (free, toggleable).
Gmail mailroom: rules, watch, labels, stats, digests, drafts — its own navig-email command (Gmail app password over IMAP), and `navig email` inside navig.

NAVIG Explore module — a universal local media/data explorer for ANY folder. Buckets files by type (image/gif/video/audio/text/document/archive), auto-reads Telegram exports, previews everything, and organizes by drag-to-class. Non-destructive. A first-party navig plugin (free, toggleable).

NAVIG Games — proactively find & auto-claim FREE games (Epic now; GOG/Amazon/Steam next) and manage your game library. A first-party navig plugin (free, toggleable). FREE-ONLY: never spends real money.

Generate images, video and audio with your own provider keys, keep the variants you like, and edit them: cut, fx, beats, tonality, sprites. Runs on its own as `navig-generate`; the shared media engine lives in `navig-media-core`.
The full GitHub toolbox (backup, mirror, export, manage): its own navig-github command, and `navig github` inside navig.
The NAVIG media suite in one install: image and video generation, voice and music, writing, and the assembly line that downloads, transcribes, scripts, narrates and publishes.

The shared media engine NAVIG's media packages run on — media types and the generator registry, the generation service, the refs library, the variant store, the provider key catalog, and the ffmpeg primitives (audio edit, video edit, frames, fx). A library: no commands of its own, runs without navig.
AI-first menu builder — auto-detects any project's stack and builds a premium interactive terminal menu with layouts, a plugin system, and a live settings panel. Standalone or via `navig menu`.
NAVIG Mini — Lightweight AI agent daemon for Raspberry Pi, NAS boxes, and low-power devices

NAVIG Mobile — pro-grade Android + iOS device operations: connect, device info, apps, file pull, screenshots, backups, plus forensics / spyware-scan / root-jailbreak assist / OSINT, and app UI automation (a11y snapshots, tap/fill, `ui assert` machine checks, evidence capture). Wired into `navig mobile` (+ `navig android` / `navig ios`). A first-party navig plugin (free, toggleable).
navig mstore -- Microsoft Store publishing verbs for NAVIG, wrapping the msstore-publish block.

navig notes -- your web sticky notes on this computer: the NAVIG Dock syncs every note you keep on a page, a site or everywhere, so you can list, search, add and export them from the command line, and NAVIG's Recall can find them (never sent to an AI unless you allow it).
Control OBS Studio from navig — scenes, sources, streams, recording, studio mode, whole obs-websocket v5 surface — its own navig-obs command, and `navig obs` inside navig.

NAVIG Pentest — the authorized-only offensive-security toolkit: passive recon (RDAP/whois, DNS, crt.sh subdomains, HTTP fingerprint) plus gated active recon (port scan, subdomain probe, template checks) behind a written-authorization engagement gate. Wired into `navig pentest` (+ `navig-warroom` / `warroom-osint` conveniences).

The content assembly line: short vertical clips cut to the beat, narrated reels, captions and hooks, and download → transcribe → script → narrate → fan-out — its own navig-pipeline command, with your own keys; also `navig pipeline` inside navig.
NAVIG Social module — compose, schedule & publish across social networks (Studio + one-call fan-out). A first-party navig plugin (free, toggleable).

NAVIG Text module — AI text generation (drafts/articles/captions/briefs) + `navig design` (agent HTML/CSS restyle + design tokens) for the Design Mode lens. A first-party navig plugin (free, toggleable). The TEXT facet of the shared media generation engine.
NAVIG Vault — a free, standalone, encrypted developer secrets manager (Doppler / 1Password-CLI / Infisical class). Installs without navig; shares one vault.

NAVIG Video module — render a channel's video formats (kinetic episodes, bulletins, motion cards) from its workspace of texts, plates and voice: timeline → frames → ffmpeg, with per-destination encode variants. A first-party navig plugin (free, toggleable).

NAVIG VM module — local VMware Workstation VMs from verified cloud images, provisioned on first boot with cloud-init and driven from `navig vm` (create, start, ssh, snapshots). A first-party navig plugin (free, toggleable).
